headlines.title: GE Vernova to supply 29.4 MW of wind capacity for Eurus Energy
headlines.summary: GE Vernova has signed an agreement with Eurus Energy Holdings Corp. to supply seven 4.2 MW-117 m wind turbines for the 29.4 MW Eurus Hiyamizutouge wind farm.

headlines.title: GE Vernova Just Signed a Major Deal in Venezuela. Is the Stock a Buy on This News Alone?
headlines.summary: GE Vernova's Venezuela deal looks significant, but the 5-gigawatt headline tells investors only part of the story.

headlines.title: GE Vernova Is ‘Wired to Win,’ Analyst Says. What It Means for the Stock.
headlines.summary: GE Vernova  finds itself in a fight it didn’t pick, besieged on two fronts.  The stock been battered as investors fret that an industry-recommended AI development deceleration will hit growth.  On Friday, Jefferies backed Vernova stock, pointing out that as electricity demand grows, along with Vernova’s installed base of power equipment, so does its parts and service revenue.

headlines.title: Bloom Energy vs. GE Vernova: Which Stock Is a Better Buy in 2026?
headlines.summary: Bloom Energy is doubling its revenue and crossing major milestones. GE Vernova has a record backlog, surging orders, and the scale to power entire national grids. Both are vital to the AI energy build-out, but only one is already indispensable.

headlines.title: GE Vernova Will Supply Turbines for Japanese Wind Farm
headlines.summary: GE Vernova's Onshore Wind division announced it has an agreement with Eurus Energy Holdings Corp. to supply seven 4.2-MW, 117-meter wind turbines for a wind farm in Japan.

description: GE Vernova Inc., an energy company, engages in the provision of various products and services that generate, transfer, orchestrate, convert, and store electricity in the United States, Europe, Asia, the Middle East, and Africa. The company operates through three segments: Power, Wind, and Electrification. The Power segment designs, manufactures, and services gas, nuclear, hydro, and steam technologies. It serves industrial, government, and other customers. The Wind segment offers wind generation technologies, including onshore and offshore wind turbines and blades. The Electrification segment provides grid solutions; power conversion; electrification software; and solar and storage solutions technologies required for the transmission, distribution, conversion, storage, and orchestration of electricity from point of generation to point of consumption. The company was incorporated in 2023 and is headquartered in Cambridge, Massachusetts.
